title: Floor-raise tests never adopt a post-clear sample (over-broad invalidation undetected)
description: python/tests/timing/test_time_sync.py:943-960 (zzw5 strengthening): each loop iteration ends without adopting a sample issued AFTER the clear, so an over-broad invalidation passes: verified mutant _clear_locked (stratum.py:438-439) setting __issuance_high_water[authority] = 2**63 (bricking the authority forever) passes all assertions, since the pre-clear candidate (seq 2) is rejected with the pinned reason either way. Fix: end each iteration with 'assert state.adopt(gnss(authority, FLOOR + 30))' (fresh issuance, above new floor) is True.
